posts.title: Free Streaming Services - Prime, Paramount+, Peacock, Youtube, Samsung
posts.description: Many streaming services are given away for free. Why pay? You read a lot online of people complaining that streaming services are too expensive. "When you sign up for all the online services , you end up spending over $100 a month - maybe $200! - and that is more than cable TV costs!" Of course, it is an idiotic argument. Most streaming services allow you to sign up for one month and then cancel.
